Both Roads Planner is a printable 2027 planner for people who put things off. I made it because most planners just fill every empty hour with work, and that never worked for me.

The idea is simple. Life goes in first. You shade in what can't move, like sleep, family, the gym and appointments. Work goes into whatever time is left. Pink is life and purple is work. If your work doesn't fit, you move the work.

The four rules:
1. Put life in first.
2. Work gets what is left.
3. Aim early. Finish about a third of the way ahead of the real deadline.
4. Start with five minutes.
